CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "banner" text,
  "brand" text NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "images" text[] NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "numReviews" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "rating" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "stock" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "product_images_elem_not_null_2f12556f" CHECK (array_position("images", NULL) IS NULL)
)
